title: Florida District 14

bio.title: Mike Beltran
bio.bio: Mike Beltran is an American attorney and politician who served in the Florida House of Representatives, representing the 70th district, which includes part of Hillsborough County. He is the Republican nominee in the 2026 election in Florida's 14th congressional district and describes himself as an ultra-conservative.

bio.title: Kathy Castor
bio.bio: Katherine Anne Castor is an American politician and lawyer serving as the U.S. representative for Florida's 14th congressional district since 2007. The district, based in Tampa, was numbered as the 11th district from 2007 to 2013.

summary: There are no qualifying public polls yet, so the forecast leans on fundamentals; partisan lean, the national environment and incumbency point to Kathy Castor +2.5.
